code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD disable alert
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::disable_alert
       Disables the current alert.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::disable_alert

DESCRIPTION
       Disables the current alert

RETURN VALUE
       Disables the current alert

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    ANTIFRAUD::disable_alert
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
